services.name: Steam (CS2, Dota 2)

target.label: Route to your nearest Valve relay (ICMP)

services.caveat: In-game ping goes through Valve's relay network, so it can be higher or lower than this.

services.name: Discord

target.label: Route to the Cloudflare edge used by Discord (ICMP). Not your voice server

services.caveat: Discord runs most voice traffic on Cloudflare's edge. A good result shows that the path to that edge is good. It does not show that Discord's voice servers are fine.
